alp.summary: PECTAA 2026–27 ALP for Computer Science & Entrepreneurship, Grade 12 (notification 1258, dated 14-11-2026). Unit 5 is fully excluded; Units 1–4 and 6–9 remain in scope subject to topic and exercise exclusions recorded in exclusionRules. The official scheme is 15 MCQs, three short groups (attempt 6 of 9 in each), and five long questions (attempt 3). Question content has not yet been authored.
